lessons.title: Threats & Attack Types
lessons.content: Understanding attacks is the first defense. KEY CONCEPTS: Malware (virus, ransomware, trojan), phishing/social engineering, DDoS, injection attacks, man-in-the-middle, zero-days. WORKED EXAMPLE: Phishing tricks a user into revealing credentials — the most common breach vector. PRACTICE: 1) Name 4 malware types. 2) Explain phishing. 3) Describe a DDoS attack.
